req.title: Create requires title
req.statement: The system shall render 'Title is required.' when POST /create omits the title field.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-016 requires that POST /create with a missing title field returns an HTTP 2xx response containing the exact text 'Title is required.' The blog.create view is login-protected, so every test must first authenticate. The violation was: test[3] had kind='negative' but heuristic='STC'. STC (State Transition Coverage) is not compatible with kind='negative' per the rule-based verifier. Fix: change test[3] heuristic from 'STC' to 'NEG', which correctly classifies the unauthenticated access as a negative test using the NEG heuristic (testing an invalid precondition state). All other tests are preserved exactly as before.

tests.name: test_create_with_valid_title_succeeds
preconditions: App is initialised with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
User 'Rahul' (id=1, password='stone') exists in the pre-loaded dataset
actions: POST /create with title='Valid Title' and body='Some body text'
expected: Response data does NOT contain 'Title is required.'
trace: R-FLASKR-016 — positive path: title present, no validation error expected
EP: valid-title partition should not produce the error message
Catches mutations that suppress the redirect or incorrectly flash the error
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()
r_login = client.post('/auth/login',
                      data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'},
                      follow_redirects=False)
assert r_login.status_code == 302
r = client.post('/create',
                data={'title': 'Valid Title', 'body': 'Some body text'},
                follow_redirects=False)
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
assert b'Title is required.' not in r.data

tests.name: test_create_with_empty_string_title_shows_error
preconditions: App is initialised with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
User 'Rahul' (id=1, password='stone') exists in the pre-loaded dataset
actions: POST /create with title='' (empty string, the boundary between absent and present) and body='Body text'
POST /create with title='X' (one character, the lower valid boundary) and body='Body text'
expected: POST /create with empty title returns HTTP 200 (re-renders the form, does not redirect)
Response body for empty title contains 'Title is required.'
POST /create with title='X' returns HTTP 302 redirect
Response for title='X' does NOT contain 'Title is required.'
trace: R-FLASKR-016 — boundary: empty string title is falsy in Python, same branch as absent title
BVA: empty string is the lower boundary of the title field; one character above would be valid
Catches off-by-one or truthiness mutations on the 'if not title' guard

tests.name: test_create_unauthenticated_redirects_to_login
preconditions: App is initialised with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
No user is logged in (fresh client session)
actions: POST /create with title='' and body='text' without prior login
expected: Response does NOT contain 'Title is required.' (login guard fires first)
trace: R-FLASKR-016 — negative: unauthenticated state must redirect before validation runs
NEG: invalid precondition (no session) triggers login_required guard before title check
Catches mutations that remove the login_required decorator or reorder guards

tests.name: test_create_title_required_error_exact_text_and_no_db_insert
preconditions: App is initialised with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
User 'Rahul' (id=1, password='stone') exists in the pre-loaded dataset
Database post count is zero before the test action
actions: POST /create with title='' and body='Should not be inserted'
Query the database post table to count rows
expected: Database post table still contains zero rows (no insert occurred)
trace: R-FLASKR-016 — decision table: title absent AND body present => error shown AND no DB write
DT: validates both the UI feedback and the side-effect suppression in one test
Catches mutations that insert a row despite missing title or that show error but still write
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db, get_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()
r_login = client.post('/auth/login',
                      data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'},
                      follow_redirects=False)
assert r_login.status_code == 302
r = client.post('/create',
                data={'title': '', 'body': 'Should not be inserted'},
                follow_redirects=True)
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Title is required.' in r.data
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import get_db
    db = get_db()
    count = db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post').fetchone()[0]
assert count == 0, f'Expected 0 posts in DB after failed create, got {count}'
